_comment: Unattended reviews held for the owner. Both plugins must give the agent `held_text`, and the owner each notice's `text` with {approve} and {why} replaced by their commands (/sentrook approve and /sentrook why on Hermes, /sentrook-approve and /sentrook-why on OpenClaw). `where` is built from its parts as `where_text`. Chat markup (`[]()<>|@` and backticks) is taken out of every field the agent can influence (job id and name, tool, target description), and the target description is capped at 160 characters. The notice never carries the risk, reason codes, scores, entity kinds or the suggested grant: Hermes copies what it sends into the agent's own transcript. `hints` lists suggested grants and what approval would set (null: refused, as the grant command would refuse it). `outcomes` says what each verdict becomes on an attended and an unattended run with review at 40 and block at 80: a block, from the line or enforced, is never held. `history` gives the action and review columns history prints for held scans. An outcome's `ceiling` is the scanner's verdict ceiling; an unattended run never lowers a block to a review with it, so a lowered block is never held.
